title: Tech Note: Creating Client/Server Applications: Managing clients, plug-ins, tips and tricks
author: Chiheb NASR, QA Engineer, 4D S.A.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the mechanics of 4D 2004's compiled client/server application generator — XML build project keys, the EnginedServer.xml auto-connect file, the automatic client-upgrade script pipeline (upgclnt.bat/upgclnt.sh), and plug-in folder precedence rules. It is squarely a Design Mode / binary structure-file era document (a decade before Project Mode) describing deployment tooling that has since been substantially reworked in modern 4D Server/Client releases, though the underlying goals — versioned client/server deployment and automatic client updates — remain a live concern in 4D today, just handled through newer mechanisms. Practically all the specific XML tag names, file names, and folder-priority details described are legacy and would need to be re-verified against a current 4D release before reuse.
related_updates: 4D's client/server build and update tooling has evolved significantly since 4D 2004/2004.1 (the note itself notes a tag rename between versions)
Modern 4D Server/Client deployment still supports automatic client updating, but the specific XML build-project schema described here is legacy and not guaranteed to match current 4D versions
